description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the RecognizeAction operation in the face and body category
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸人体（facebody）类目下的动作行为识别RecognizeAction的语法及示例
name: RecognizeAction

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the input content type, which includes video and image. Valid values:

0: Indicates that the input is a video URL or a video Base64 encoding character string.

1: Indicates that the input is an image URL or an image Base64 encoding character string.

Other values: Invalid input
parameters.help_zh:
输入内容类型，包括视频和图像两种类型。

0：表示输入视频URL或视频Base64编码字符串。

1：表示输入图像URL或图像Base64编码字符串。

其他：非法输入
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video. This parameter is required when Type is set to 0. An OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region is recommended. For files stored locally or in OSS buckets outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: Type为0时需要输入的视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

fields.help_en: The URL of the image. This parameter is required when Type is set to 1. You must enter exactly 4 images. The 4 images should be evenly sampled from a 2-second video, and their resolutions and number of channels must be identical. An OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region is recommended. For files stored locally or in OSS buckets outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
fields.help_zh: Type为1时需要输入的图像URL地址，必须输入4张图像，且4张图像建议为两秒钟视频均匀采样的图像，分辨率和通道数必须一致。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The Base64-encoded string of the image. If both this parameter and URL are specified, URL takes precedence. For more information about how to encode a file in Base64, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
fields.help_zh: 图像Base64编码字符串，与URL共存时，URL优先。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
fields.name: image_data

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded string of the video. If both this parameter and VideoUrl are specified, VideoUrl takes precedence. For more information about how to encode a file in Base64, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频Base64编码字符串，与VideoURL共存时，VideoURL优先。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.name: video_data

Boxes.description_en: The list of bounding boxes for the specific action
Boxes.description_zh: 具体动作的坐标框列表

items.description_en: The bounding box information for the specific action
items.description_zh: 具体动作的坐标框信息

items.description_en:
The confidence score of the action category. Valid values: 0 to 1. A higher value indicates a more accurate recognition result. The system provides threshold standards for different actions based on algorithms. You can adjust the thresholds based on your business requirements.

Raising hands: 0.5. A score below 0.5 indicates that the action is not raising hands. Otherwise, the action is raising hands.

Eating or drinking: 0.5. A score below 0.5 indicates that the action is not eating or drinking. Otherwise, the action is eating or drinking.

Smoking: 0.5. A score below 0.5 indicates that the action is not smoking. Otherwise, the action is smoking.

Making a phone call: 0.5. A score below 0.5 indicates that the action is not making a phone call. Otherwise, the action is making a phone call.

Using a mobile phone: 0.5. A score below 0.5 indicates that the action is not using a mobile phone. Otherwise, the action is using a mobile phone.

Sleeping on a desk: 0.5. A score below 0.5 indicates that the action is not sleeping on a desk. Otherwise, the action is sleeping on a desk.

Falling: 0.5. A score below 0.5 indicates that the action is not falling. Otherwise, the action is falling.
Washing hands: 0.5. A score below 0.5 indicates that the action is not washing hands. Otherwise, the action is washing hands.
Taking photos: 0.5. A score below 0.5 indicates that the action is not taking photos. Otherwise, the action is taking photos
items.description_zh:
行为类别的置信度。取值范围0~1，值越大，识别到的动作越准确。系统根据算法，为不同的动作给出判断的阈值标准，您也可以根据自己的实际情况，对判断的阈值标准进行调整。

举手：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是举手行为，否则认为是举手行为。）

吃喝：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是吃喝行为，否则认为是吃喝行为。）

吸烟：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是吸烟行为，否则认为是吸烟行为。）

打电话：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是打电话行为，否则认为是打电话行为。）

玩手机：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是玩手机行为，否则认为是玩手机行为。）

趴桌睡觉：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是趴桌睡觉行为，否则认为是趴桌睡觉行为。）

跌倒：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是跌倒行为，否则认为是跌倒行为。）
洗手：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是洗手行为，否则认为是洗手行为。）
拍照：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是拍照行为，否则认为是拍照行为。）

Timestamp.description_en: The timestamp indicating when the current action occurs in the video or image
Timestamp.description_zh: 当前行为在视频或者图像中发生的时间戳信息
